name: counter-component
description: Create a counter component with increment/decrement buttons

variants.typescript: Write a TypeScript module that exports a Counter class with methods to get the current count and increment/decrement it. Include proper type annotations.
variants.javascript: Write a JavaScript module that exports a Counter class with methods to get the current count and increment/decrement it.
variants.javascript-jsdoc: Write a JavaScript module with JSDoc annotations that exports a Counter class with methods to get the current count and increment/decrement it. Include proper JSDoc types.
variants.javascript-vanilla-web:
Create a complete vanilla JavaScript counter component with HTML and CSS. Include:
- An HTML structure with a count display and two buttons (+ and -)
- CSS for basic styling (centered layout, styled buttons)
- JavaScript to handle clicks and update the display
- No frameworks, just vanilla DOM APIs
- Return the complete implementation as a single HTML file with inline CSS and JS
variants.javascript-vanilla-web-jsdoc:
Create a complete vanilla JavaScript counter component with JSDoc type annotations. Include:
- An HTML structure with a count display and two buttons (+ and -)
- CSS for basic styling (centered layout, styled buttons)
- JavaScript with complete JSDoc type annotations
- No frameworks, just vanilla DOM APIs
- Document all functions with @param, @return, etc.
- Return the complete implementation as a single HTML file
variants.typescript-vanilla-web:
Create a counter component using TypeScript with vanilla Web APIs. Include:
- TypeScript code with proper type annotations
- DOM manipulation using standard Web APIs
- Event handling with proper types
- No frameworks or libraries
- Provide both the TypeScript source and the HTML structure needed
variants.typescript-react:
Create a Counter component in TypeScript React. Include:
- A functional component with TypeScript types
- useState hook for state management
- Props interface if needed
- Proper TypeScript annotations
- Clean, modern React patterns
- Minimal dependencies (just React)
